stories.title: The Jam Stall
stories.picture: 暖色晨市里，一个木摊位上摆着玻璃罐果酱和一只烤火鸡，女孩端着小托盘，用舌尖轻轻试了一点果酱。
paragraphs: Mia stopped at a small stall in the morning market.
米娅在早市上停在一个小摊位前。
A roast turkey sat beside several jars of jam.
一只烤火鸡放在几罐果酱旁边。
The seller placed a little jam on a tray for her to try.
摊主把一点果酱放在托盘上，让她尝尝。
She touched it with the tip of her tongue.
她用舌尖碰了碰果酱。
The jam was sweet, but not too sweet.
果酱是甜的，但并不太甜。
"Would you like some turkey as well?" the seller asked.
「要不要也来一点火鸡？」摊主问。
Mia smiled and bought a small jar to take home.
米娅笑了笑，买了一小罐带回家。
She thanked the seller and walked on through the market.
她谢过摊主，继续往集市里走。

stories.title: Trade in Town
stories.picture: 小镇集市的石板路上，几个农夫把蔬菜和水果摆上木桌，正和镇上的人做买卖。
paragraphs: On market day, farmers came into town to trade.
赶集的日子，农夫们进城来做买卖。
They brought fresh produce from the fields.
他们从田里带来了新鲜的农产品。
Some baskets did not belong to the farmers themselves.
有些篮子并不属于这些农夫自己。
Neighbours had asked them to sell fruit as well.
邻居也托他们把水果一并卖掉。
The trade was slow at first.
一开始买卖有些冷清。
Then more people from town arrived with bags.
后来镇上更多人提着袋子来了。
By noon, most of the produce was gone.
到了中午，大部分农产品都卖完了。
The farmers counted their money and went home.
农夫们点过钱，就回家了。

stories.title: The New Invention
stories.picture: 一间温暖的小工作室里，年轻人把刚做成的小装置放在木桌上，窗外是傍晚的金光。
paragraphs: Lin wanted to invent a tool to clean dusty books.
林想发明一种工具，用来清理落了灰的书。
His first invention did not work at all.
他的第一件发明根本没法用。
He tried again and again in the small workroom.
他在小小的工作室里一次又一次地尝试。
Eventually, the little machine held a book and blew the dust away.
最终，这台小机器能夹住书，把灰尘吹走。
A teacher saw it and told others about it.
一位老师看见了，就告诉了其他人。
Lin did not care much about fame.
林并不怎么在意名声。
He only wanted the invention to be useful.
他只希望这件发明能派上用场。
Still, his name began to travel around the school.
不过，他的名字还是开始在学校里传开了。

stories.title: Different Approaches
stories.picture: 教室黑板前，几个学生围着一道难解的题，桌上摊开几种不同的解题草稿。
paragraphs: The last question was tough, and no one felt sure.
最后一道题很棘手，谁都没有把握。
"This problem has potential," the teacher said.
「这道题很有潜力。」老师说。
She asked them to try different approaches.
她让他们试试不同的方法。
One idea seemed weak at first.
有一个想法起初显得不怎么样。
They had to prove it with clear numbers.
他们必须用清楚的数字来证明它。
The second approach was slower, but easier to follow.
第二种方法更慢，但更容易跟上。
In the end, the answer was correct.
最后，答案是对的。
The tough question no longer looked impossible.
那道棘手的题看起来不再不可能了。

stories.title: The School Debate
stories.picture: 放学后的教室里，学生们围坐成两排，一位老师站在中间，安静地听双方发言。
paragraphs: There was a debate after class about school rules.
课后有一场关于校规的辩论。
Some students talked about politics in the news as well.
有些学生也谈到了新闻里的政治。
"We have a duty to listen," the teacher said.
「我们有责任去听。」老师说。
A boy began to complain that the time was too short.
一个男孩开始抱怨时间太短。
The others stayed polite and waited for their turn.
其他人保持礼貌，等着轮到自己。
He then spoke more slowly and more clearly.
后来他讲得更慢、更清楚了。
The debate did not choose a winner.
这场辩论没有选出赢家。
Everyone left with something to think about.
每个人离开时都带着一点要思考的东西。

stories.title: A Guest from the Province
stories.picture: 明亮的会议室里，一位外省来的客人站在长桌前，平静地说明自己的想法，窗外是城市的午后光线。
paragraphs: A certain guest arrived from another province.
某一位客人从另一个省来了。
She had just visited the capital the day before.
她前一天刚去过首都。
In the meeting room, she began to state her ideas.
在会议室里，她开始陈述自己的想法。
Her voice was calm and clear.
她的声音平静而清楚。
Some people did not agree with every point.
有些人并不同意每一个观点。
Still, they let her state the plan to the end.
但他们还是让她把计划陈述完。
"The province has a new school programme," she said.
「这个省有一项新的学校计划。」她说。
Later, they walked her back to the gate.
后来，他们送她走到门口。

stories.title: At the Memorial
stories.picture: 暮色中的安静广场上，一位老人在高高的纪念碑下摆上鲜花，碑身投下长长的影子。
paragraphs: We stood below the tall memorial in the quiet square.
我们站在安静广场上那座高高的纪念碑下面。
An old comrade placed flowers at the stone.
一位老同志把花放在石碑前。
He spoke of brotherhood in the hard years.
他谈起那些艰难岁月里兄弟般的情谊。
It took courage to remember those days.
记起那些日子，是需要勇气的。
Below the names, there were several fresh flowers.
在那些名字下面，放着几束新鲜的花。
A child asked why the memorial was built.
一个孩子问，为什么要建这座纪念碑。
The old man answered in a soft voice.
老人用很轻的声音回答了。
We stayed until the square grew dark.
我们一直待到广场暗下来。

stories.title: The Wounded Messenger
stories.picture: 帐营里，一名受伤的信使靠在毯子上，医生在一旁端着水，帐外是刚停息的尘土。
paragraphs: After the fight, a wounded man was carried into the tent.
战斗结束后，一名受伤的人被抬进帐篷。
He had been a victim of a sudden shot.
他是一声突然的枪响的受害者。
The enemy had already gone back into the hills.
敌人已经退回山里了。
The wounded man tried to sit up.
这个受伤的人想坐起来。
"The shot came from the trees," he said.
「枪声是从树林里传来的。」他说。
People in the tent grew quiet.
帐篷里的人安静了下来。
They gave him water and asked him to rest.
他们递给他水，让他休息。
In the morning, he was able to speak again.
到了早晨，他又能开口说话了。

stories.title: The Pacific Captain
stories.picture: 银色海光里，船长站在甲板的栏杆旁看向两艘靠近的小船，一名水手举起相机，远处是平静的太平洋。
paragraphs: The captain stood on the ship in the Pacific.
船长站在太平洋上的那艘船上。
The sea was calm after a long night.
经过漫长的一夜，海面平静了。
Then two boats almost had a crash near the side.
这时，两艘小船差点儿在船舷旁相撞。
The captain called out and turned the wheel.
船长大声喊着，转动了舵轮。
A sailor took out a camera to record the moment.
一名水手拿出相机，记下了这一刻。
The light on the Pacific was silver and soft.
太平洋上的光是银色的，也很柔和。
No one was hurt, and the boats moved apart.
没有人受伤，两艘小船随后分开了。
The captain did not leave the deck until both were safe.
直到两艘船都安全了，船长才离开甲板。

stories.title: After the Opera
stories.picture: 歌剧院散场后的灯火街上，一位女演员把戏服搭在手臂上，在门口停下来整理靴子，不远处夜总会门口正透出暖光。
paragraphs: After the opera, the street was full of lights.
歌剧散场后，街上满是灯光。
Anna still had her stage costume over her arm.
安娜还把舞台上的戏服搭在手臂上。
She stopped to fix her boot by the door.
她在门口停下来，整理自己的靴子。
They passed a busy night-club with music at the door.
她们路过一家热闹的夜总会，门口传出音乐。
Anna laughed and said she was too tired to go in.
安娜笑着说，她太累了，不想进去。
She folded the costume carefully over her arm.
她把戏服小心地叠好，仍搭在手臂上。
The night air felt cool after the warm opera house.
从温暖的歌剧院出来，夜里的空气显得很凉。
They walked home under the yellow lamps.
她们在黄色的灯光下走回家。

stories.title: The Old Photograph
stories.picture: 黄昏的房间里，一位老妇人把发黄的旧照片托在膝上，照片中的男子打着一条深色领带，膝上坐着一个微笑的小孩。
paragraphs: In the old photograph, Grandpa had worn his father's necktie.
在那张旧照片里，爷爷戴着他父亲的领带。
A little girl sat on his lap and smiled.
一个小女孩坐在他的膝上，微笑着。
Grandma looked at the picture for a long time.
奶奶看了那张照片很久。
"I still envy that calm look on his face," she said.
「我还是羡慕他脸上那种平静的神情。」她说。
The necktie was dark and carefully tied.
那条领带是深色的，系得很仔细。
She held the photograph on her lap.
她把照片放在膝上托着。
"He had worn it only on special days," she added.
「他只在特别的日子才戴它。」她又说。
The room stayed quiet while she remembered.
她回忆的时候，房间里一直很安静。

stories.title: Composition Day
stories.picture: 明亮的教室里，学生们低头写着作文，讲台上放着听写本和一小叠测验卷，窗外是安静的校园。
paragraphs: In the morning, the class had a dictation.
早上，这节课先进行了听写。
Then they wrote a short composition about a family trip.
接着他们写了一篇关于家庭旅行的短作文。
After lunch there was a quiz on new words.
午饭后，又有一次生词测验。
The last task was an essay, a little longer than the composition.
最后一项任务是一篇随笔，比那篇作文稍长一些。
One student used an idiom in the first line.
有一个学生在第一句里用了一条习语。
The teacher smiled when she read it.
老师读到的时候笑了。
"An idiom can make a sentence feel alive," she said.
「一条习语能让句子活起来。」她说。
Everyone handed in the essay before the bell.
铃声响起之前，大家都交了随笔。

stories.title: One Cue
stories.picture: 排练室的走廊墙边贴着一张工整的台词纸，女孩抱着吉他坐在长椅上，正轻轻弹一段开场的曲调。
paragraphs: Before the play, Mina played a tune to greet the listeners.
开演前，米娜弹了一段曲调，向听众打招呼。
She had written the dialogue on a neat sheet of paper.
她把对话写在一张整齐的纸上。
The sheet was taped to the wall, ready for the actors.
那张纸被贴在墙上，好让演员随时看。
"Wait for my cue," she said.
「等我的提示。」她说。
The first cue was a soft knock.
第一个提示是一声轻轻的敲门。
Then the dialogue began, line by line.
随后，对话一行一行地开始了。
People in the room leaned forward to listen.
房间里的人探身向前听着。
At the end, Mina played the same tune again.
结束时，米娜又弹了同一段曲调。

stories.title: The Quiet Corridor
stories.picture: 洒满午后阳光的长走廊里，木长凳上放着一个软垫，墙边的花瓶里插着花，一名佣人正轻轻走过。
paragraphs: A vase of flowers stood in the long corridor.
长走廊里立着一只插了花的花瓶。
A servant walked by with careful steps.
一名佣人小心翼翼地走了过去。
She stopped to tidy a cushion on the wooden bench.
她停下来，把木长凳上的垫子整理整齐。
"Does this vase belong here?" a visitor asked.
「这只花瓶是放在这里的吗？」一位访客问。
"Yes," the servant said. "It belongs to the hall."
「是的，」佣人说。「它是大厅的。」
The corridor was quiet and smelled of clean wood.
走廊很安静，有一股干净木头的气味。
The visitor sat down on the tidy bench.
访客在整洁的长凳上坐了下来。
Afternoon light fell across the floor.
午后的光线落在地板上。

stories.title: Piles of Housework
stories.picture: 温暖的家中，一位家庭主妇和儿子正把叠好的衣物塞进抽屉，一旁的椅子上还堆着待整理的毛巾。
paragraphs: Lately the house had been busy and a little messy.
最近家里又忙又有些乱。
The housewife looked at the clothes that had begun to pile up.
家庭主妇看着那些开始堆起来的衣服。
She began to tuck the clean shirts into a drawer.
她开始把干净的衬衫塞进抽屉。
"I can help," her son said.
「我可以帮忙。」她的儿子说。
Together they made a neat pile of towels.
他们一起把毛巾叠成整齐的一堆。
She showed him how to tuck the edges in.
她教他怎样把边缘掖好。
Lately he had wanted to be useful after school.
最近他放学后也想帮上忙。
By evening, the room looked light again.
到了傍晚，房间看起来又清爽了。

stories.title: The Muddy Lane
stories.picture: 雨后狭窄的泥路上，一辆装满木柴的马车陷在泥里，车夫拉着绳子，马正在用力前行。
paragraphs: The lane was narrow and muddy after the rain.
雨后，这条小路又窄又泥泞。
A cart carried a heavy load of wood.
一辆马车载着沉重的木柴。
The load was tied with a thick rope.
那些木柴用一根粗绳子捆着。
The wheels began to sink into the mud.
轮子开始往泥里陷。
The driver tried to shake the rope free.
车夫试着把绳子抖松。
The horse gave a shake and pulled again.
马晃了一下，又拉了起来。
Slowly, the cart moved down the lane.
马车慢慢沿着小路向前移动。
They did not stop until the ground was firm.
直到地面变扎实，他们才停下来。

stories.title: The Bend by the Tomb
stories.picture: 黄昏的土路在一座旧坟旁急转，草丛里立着一门生锈的旧炮，两个行人在拐弯处放慢了脚步。
paragraphs: The path made a sharp bend beside an old tomb.
小路在一座旧坟墓旁转了一个急弯。
A rusted cannon stood in the grass nearby.
附近的草丛里立着一门生锈的大炮。
The place could frighten a child at dusk.
在黄昏时，这地方可能会吓到小孩。
They slowed down at the bend and looked around.
他们在拐弯处放慢脚步，四周看了看。
The tomb was quiet, and no one was there.
坟墓很安静，没有别的人。
A bird flew up from behind the cannon.
一只鸟从大炮后面飞了起来。
The sound did not frighten them for long.
那声音并没有让他们害怕很久。
They walked on before the light was gone.
他们趁天还没黑，继续往前走。

stories.title: A Trip Abroad
stories.picture: 清晨的机场大厅里，一个女孩提着行李箱走向登机口，父母站在后方望着她，窗外有飞机正在滑行。
paragraphs: Yuan was going abroad for the first time.
袁是第一次出国。
She would fly to a European city in the morning.
她早上将乘飞机去一座欧洲城市。
Her parents would stay on the mainland and wait for her call.
她的父母会留在大陆，等她的电话。
She had never visited a European street before.
她以前从没走过欧洲的街道。
At the airport, she watched the planes fly over the roof.
在机场，她看着飞机从屋顶上方飞过。
"I'll write when I arrive," she told them.
「我到了就写信。」她对他们说。
The mainland felt far away as she walked to the gate.
走向登机口时，大陆忽然显得很远。
She held her passport and tried to smile.
她握着护照，努力笑了笑。

stories.title: The Route to the Meeting
stories.picture: 清晨的车站大厅里，两个学生对照一张小地图，看着指示牌上的路线，人群在他们身后流动。
paragraphs: They had to attend a meeting in the next city.
他们得去邻近的城市出席一场会合。
The teacher gave them an instruction about the route.
老师给了他们一条关于路线的说明。
"Take the early bus to the station," she said.
「坐早班车去车站。」她说。
The instruction was short and easy to follow.
那条说明很短，也很容易照着做。
They studied the route on a small map.
他们在一张小地图上查看路线。
At the station, the hall was already crowded.
到了车站，大厅里已经很拥挤。
They arrived in time to attend the first talk.
他们及时赶到，赶上了第一场讲座。
On the way home, they used the same route.
回家时，他们走了同一条路线。

stories.title: Inside the Old Court
stories.picture: 旧法庭门口站着一名守卫，旁边能看见小教堂的屋顶，屋里已有几位出席的人安静地坐着。
paragraphs: A guard stood at the door of the old court.
一名守卫站在旧法庭的门口。
Next to it, a small church bell was ringing.
旁边，一座小教堂的钟正在响。
People who were present sat down and grew quiet.
出席的人坐下来，渐渐安静了。
The guard checked each name on a list.
守卫核对名单上的每一个名字。
Someone from the church had come to listen as well.
教堂里也有人过来旁听。
A woman was present with a small bag on her knees.
一位女士也出席了，膝上放着一个小包。
The court began when the doors were closed.
门关上后，法庭开始了。
From the window, they could see the church roof.
从窗户望出去，能看见教堂的屋顶。

stories.title: A Loud Quarrel
stories.picture: 校园院子的树荫下，两个男孩刚吵完，一个低下头道歉，几个同学站在一旁看着他们。
paragraphs: Two boys began to quarrel in the yard.
两个男孩在院子里争吵起来。
One of them gave a rude shout.
其中一个粗鲁地喊了一声。
"Don't you dare say that again!" the other cried.
「你敢再说一遍试试！」另一个叫道。
Their friends ran over and asked them to stop.
朋友们跑过来，叫他们停下来。
After a while, the shout died away.
过了一会儿，喊声平息了。
The first boy offered an apology.
先吵起来的那个男孩道了歉。
He said he had been rude, and he was sorry.
他说自己刚才很无礼，他很抱歉。
They stood still for a moment, then walked off together.
他们静静站了一会儿，然后一起走开了。

stories.title: The Pioneer's Tale
stories.picture: 炉火照亮的房间里，祖父坐在孩子们中间讲述故事，窗外是夜里的小定居点。
paragraphs: Grandfather told a splendid tale about a pioneer.
祖父讲了一个关于开拓者的精彩故事。
In the tale, the pioneer came forth to warn the town.
在故事里，那个开拓者站出来，向镇子发出警告。
It was in the twentieth year of the little settlement.
那是这个小定居点的第二十年。
"He came forth at sunrise," Grandfather said.
「他是在日出时站出来的。」祖父说。
The tale was short, but the room felt wide.
故事不长，房间却显得开阔了。
A splendid fire burned in the stove.
炉子里燃着很旺的火。
The children asked to hear it a second time.
孩子们要求再听一遍。
They sat close together until the story ended.
他们靠在一起坐着，直到故事讲完。

stories.title: The Astronaut
stories.picture: 夜里的窗边，一个女孩把打开的画册放在膝上，书页上是一名宇航员和发光的设备，窗外是深色的天空。
paragraphs: Mei liked to imagine life as an astronaut.
梅喜欢想象自己成为一名宇航员的生活。
In her book, the astronaut checked every piece of equipment.
在她的书里，那名宇航员检查着每一件装备。
When a door failed to lock, he had to escape the broken room.
一扇门没能锁上时，他只得逃出那间坏掉的房间。
She tried to imagine the Earth far below.
她试着想象远处下方的地球。
The equipment in the picture looked heavy and bright.
画里的装备看起来又沉又亮。
"Could I escape danger so calmly?" she wondered.
「我也能这么冷静地脱离危险吗？」她想。
She closed the book and looked at the sky.
她合上书，望向天空。
For a moment, the night felt close and very large.
有那么一会儿，夜空显得又近又广阔。

stories.title: First Dip in the Pool
stories.picture: 游泳馆浅水区旁，老师看着一个男孩把一只脚伸进水里，后面的围栏边有一架在风中轻晃的秋千。
paragraphs: At the swimming club, the teacher told Ken to dip a foot in first.
在游泳俱乐部，老师叫肯先把一只脚伸进水里试试。
A swing stood near the fence, moving a little in the wind.
围栏边立着一架秋千，在风里轻轻晃着。
After the lesson, a girl asked him a riddle.
课后，一个女孩给他出了一则谜语。
Ken could not guess it, and she would not tell him yet.
肯猜不出来，而她暂时也不想告诉他。
He asked her to shut the door of the changing room.
他请她把更衣室的门关上。
She did shut it, then gave him the answer to the riddle.
她确实关上了门，然后把谜底告诉了他。
Ken laughed and sat down to take off his wet shoes.
肯笑了，坐下来脱湿鞋子。
The water on the floor still shone from his first dip.
地板上的水还在发亮，那是他第一次试水留下的。

stories.title: In the Cab
stories.picture: 雨天的卡车驾驶室里，司机握着方向盘等雨变小，玻璃上有一层薄雾，窗外不时有车辆驶过。
paragraphs: The driver sat in the cab and waited for the rain to pass.
司机坐在驾驶室里，等雨过去。
The weather had been mild, but today was wet.
天气本来很温和，可今天却很湿。
"Is anything the matter?" a passenger asked.
「出什么事了吗？」一名乘客问。
"No," he said. "We can go whenever the road is clear."
「没有，」他说。「等路一清，我们随时可以走。」
The cab felt warm, and the window was a little foggy.
驾驶室里很暖和，车窗上有一点雾。
Whenever a truck passed, water hit the glass.
每当有卡车经过，水就会打在玻璃上。
It did not matter if they left a few minutes late.
晚几分钟出发也不要紧。
When the rain grew mild again, he started the engine.
雨又变得温和之后，他发动了引擎。

stories.title: A Quiet Spot
stories.picture: 公园老树下，一个女孩在安静的角落挖开一小块土，准备把一只小盒子埋进去，远处教堂的钟楼正亮着暖光。
paragraphs: She found a quiet spot under the old trees.
她在老树下找到一处安静的地点。
She wanted to bury a small box of family letters there.
她想把一盒家里的信埋在那里。
The church clock began to strike four.
教堂的钟开始敲四点。
After the first strike, the park felt even quieter.
敲过第一下后，公园显得更安静了。
She dug a little hole and set the box in the spot.
她挖了一个小坑，把盒子放进那个地点。
Then she covered the box with soft earth.
接着，她用松软的土把盒子盖好。
A neighbour had once said she always came here with her grandmother.
一位邻居曾经说过，她以前总是和外祖母一起来这里。
She stood up when the clock finished and walked home.
钟声结束后，她站起身，走回了家。
